releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.28 - Visual Memory Fixes, Memory Optimization & UI Streamlining
releaseNotes:
* Fix 0-hits issue in learned ad patterns by registering true 64-bit difference hashes (dHash)
* 99.2% memory reduction for history screenshots, eliminating main-thread UI jank & OOM risk
* Auto-launch floating HUD bubble and active session controls when auto-start activates
* Pre-compiled custom keyword regex cache and symbol containment matching
* Replaced deprecated AccessibilityEvent obtain/recycle APIs with lightweight event trigger channel
* Compact, deduplicated session history summary banner on History screen
* Dynamic cross-clamped Reaction Delay sliders in Settings
